about: The vertical arithmetic every visual layer reads: rows of 20px in a 100px Viewport unless a case says otherwise. From tests/ExGrid.Tests/ViewportGeometryTests.cs.
subject: ViewportGeometry

cases.name: ADR-0013: scrollbar length is total rows × row height, whether or not they are in the Window
ADR-0004: a Viewport paints what fits plus the row straddling its bottom edge
ADR-0004: a Viewport a pixel taller paints one row more
ADR-0013: an offset on a row boundary starts at that row
ADR-0013: fractional heights are carried, not rounded: the drift they cause is the trap
ADR-0001: an offset past the end lands on the last full Viewport, never on nothing
ADR-0013: a negative offset is a browser artefact (rubber-band scrolling), and reads as the top
ADR-0013: a total shorter than the Viewport paints only what exists
ADR-0001: no rows slices to nothing, not to an empty range
ADR-0004: a move of more than one Viewport is a fling
ADR-0012: the header cancels out, so revealing a row above the Viewport puts it at row × row height
ADR-0012: reaching down scrolls just far enough to show the whole row against the bottom
ADR-0012: a row already on screen does not move the offset
ADR-0012: the last row is revealed at the furthest the browser scrolls, not past it
ADR-0013/0017: the most rows of 28px a browser can scroll are accepted
ADR-0013/0017: one row past what a browser can scroll is refused, and says to page
ADR-0008: a pointer position names the row it lands in
ADR-0008: a pointer past the content clamps to the end row, even past what an int holds
ADR-0008: with no rows there is no row to point at
ADR-0013: a row height that is not a positive number of pixels is refused
cases.saying: RowHeight is a finite, positive number of pixels

cases.name: ADR-0013: a row height that is not a number is refused
ADR-0013: a Viewport height that is not a positive number of pixels is refused
cases.saying: ViewportHeight is a finite, positive number of pixels

cases.name: ADR-0013: a negative row count is refused
ADR-0013: offsets and rows outside what a grid has are refused by name
